name: Pagiel
overview: Pagiel, identified as the son of Ocran, served as the leader and captain of the tribe of Asher during the time of the Exodus. Scripture highlights his role in organizing and leading his tribe, as seen in Numbers where he is repeatedly named as the prince and captain responsible for the tribe's encampment and offerings. His leadership is notably marked by his participation in the sacrificial peace offerings, demonstrating his active role in the worship and dedication of the people to God during their journey.
